messages:
ryan: spotted short corrected ECC wave on eu-west4 rack7 NVMEs, blocked 10 GPU attaches.

zara: any fw or kernel change recently?

ryan: firmware roll 2.1.10 finished ~3h ago. dmesg snippet:
```
[1761999998.1] nvme0: corrected ECC errors: 256 flips in 60s
[1761999999.2] janitor: evicting /scratch/node-07/ephemeral-77 (score 90)
```

mike: ok pause janitor on that rack and hold new attaches.

ryan: running: `opsctl janitor pause --selector rack=eu-west4-rack7` and `scheduler.hold add --match rack=eu-west4-rack7 --ttl 20m --note ecc-spike`

ops-bot: pending attaches in eu-west4-rack7 = 10 (7 preemptible, 3 reserved). Holds applied.

zara: collect nvme-cli smart/error logs and upload, reduce janitor concurrency region-wide to 2.

ryan: uploaded /tmp/nvme-dumps/rack7-1762000000.tar.gz. set janitor concurrency: `opsctl janitor config set --region eu-west4 --max-concurrency 2`.

mike: monitor SMART deltas for 15m, vendor escalation if not stable.

ryan: update @5m: ECC deltas dropped from +250 -> +12 after pause. cooling down.

zara: filing INC-10055 and tagging runbook storage/ecc-spike.
